comment: What /artifact-to-unity last cloned into the game, per vessel. pageSha: the commit of the studio page the clone read; decisionsThrough: the newest artifact decision (createdAt / at) already applied. The next clone starts from here.

Stoat.result: 50 mapped parameters match the artifact (studio_to_unity.py --check). Cloned the waves: the light shells in and out, the gravitational wave (lens + prisms), dieS, whSizeX. The shared log held no newer decision (only d16-d17, no settings snapshot).

Shrike.result: First clone: the whole kit (docking, Nest, Void Lance, Void Sling, Targeting Array + missiles, the thin / thick trail) ported from the page's stepPilot into ShrikeExecutor / ShrikeRules, the prefab rebuilt from BrittleStar.prefab (author_shrike_assets.py). 29 mapped parameters match (studio_to_unity.py --check); the five elemental ranges ported by hand into ShrikeConfig.asset and held by ShrikeConfigTests. The decision log was empty. 2026-10-15 later: Garrett's control/flora redesign was built in Unity directly (LT zoom, RT by mode, Mass detach-and-nest, missile-growing flora, priority lock, Void Pierce); the studio page is now BEHIND the game - see R_VesselActions/SHRIKE.md section 6. nestHealth / nestHealthMax / crystalHealth unmapped (retired in the game).
